title: Specimen
summary: A design-token sample for spacing, size, radius, shadow and layer tokens, drawn at its resolved value with the token name and value as text.

props.name: token
props.description: A CSS custom property to sample, for example "--space-4", "--radius-md", "--shadow-card" or "--z-sticky"; resolved against this element's computed style, so it follows the theme and density in effect.

props.name: kind
props.description: One of space, radius, shadow, size or layer. How to draw the token: a bar of the resolved length (space, size), a corner sample (radius), an elevated tile (shadow) or a chip with the number (layer). Inferred from the token prefix (--space-, --radius-, --shadow-, --z-, --touch-) when empty.

slots.description: Optional label shown instead of the token name.

parts.name: shape
parts.description: The drawing: the bar, the corner sample, the shadow tile or the layer chip.

parts.name: info
parts.description: The wrapper around the name and the value.

parts.name: name
parts.description: The token name, or the slotted label.

parts.name: token
parts.description: The token name shown when no label is slotted.

parts.name: value
parts.description: The resolved value, with the measured pixel length for a bar.

a11y: The drawing is decorative (aria-hidden); the token name and the resolved value are text, so the result never depends on the picture alone.
